posts.title: Big Sunscreen Recall...Check Yours Now!
posts.excerpt: In case you haven't checked the news today, Johnson & Johnson issued a recall on five popular sunscreens. Head over here to see their full press release.
posts.text:
In case you haven't checked the news today, Johnson & Johnson issued a recall on five popular sunscreens. Head over here to see their full press release.
They identified benzene in some samples, a human carcinogen. The affected products are:
"NEUTROGENA® Beach Defense® aerosol sunscreen,
NEUTROGENA® Cool Dry Sport aerosol sunscreen,
NEUTROGENA® Invisible Daily™ defense aerosol sunscreen,
NEUTROGENA® Ultra Sheer® aerosol sunscreen, and
AVEENO® Protect + Refresh aerosol sunscreen."
"Consumers should stop using these specific products and appropriately discard them. Consumers may contact the JJCI Consumer Care Center 24/7 with questions or to request a refund by calling 1-800-458-1673. Consumers should contact their physician or healthcare provider if they have any questions, concerns or have experienced any problems related to using these aerosol sunscreen products. JJCI is also notifying its distributors and retailers by letter and is arranging for returns of all recalled products."
Sunscreen is so critical in AZ, you'll definitely want to make sure yours is not on the list.
Ugh!

posts.title: As Seen on 3TV...Deals on Fall Decorations, Fall Festivals, and Lots More! We'll All Be Festive for Less!
posts.excerpt: Thanks so much for tuning into my Your Life Arizona segment about great deals on fall decorations, fall decor, and more to make us all more festive for less.…
posts.text:
Thanks so much for tuning into my Your Life Arizona segment about great deals on fall decorations, fall decor, and more to make us all more festive for less. If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the totally FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list (unsubscribe at anytime). Please tell a friend about my site too so we can all “live life better for less” together. You can also find out first about the latest and greatest bargains when you follow Alicia’s Deals on Instagram, “like” Alicia’s Deals on Facebook and follow me on Twitter.
Fall is here and there are so many deals to help us celebrate the season for less!
I LOVE holiday inflatables! I think they give a great bang for the buck and they are crazy easy to set up.
Head over here where you'll find an 8 foot long inflatable pumpkin patch on sale for $49.98 at Home Depot, usually $62.98!
I'm also really excited about this 4 foot inflatable turkey for $32.98. Thanksgiving is my holiday and I'm just thinking of all of the photo opportunities with the kids on Thanksgiving!
If you're looking for a fun fall festival, think about checking out the Tempe Sister Cities Four Peaks Oktoberfest. It's going on October 11th-13th at Tempe Town Lake and admission is totally FREE! Be sure to enjoy a bratwurst and check out the fun areas for the kiddos. I have two personal Oktoberfest stories...first I went to Germany as a student ambassador in high school with Sister Cities from the money raised from this event...if you know a high school Junior in Tempe tell them to apply, you can find more information here! Second I ran into my husband at this Oktoberfest nineteen years ago. I am a big fan for life.
One of my favorite places to find unique Halloween costumes is thrift stores. I especially love Savers, they have locations around town and the donations of clothing and household items benefit Big Brothers Big Sisters of Central Arizona, an organization near and dear to my heart. Join the Super Savers club here and get a coupon for $3 off your $10 purchase or mark your calendar for October 14th when clothing will be half off. Thrifting can be so much fun (and much easier on your wallet)! The treasures you'll find!
If you're already planning your Halloween night, make sure to add a trip to Krispy Kreme to your trick or treat schedule. Anyone who comes in with a costume on gets a FREE doughnut, head over here for more information.
For the Real Housewives Fans I was THRILLED to get to meet Tamra and Eddie Judge on set! So much fun!
Enjoy and happy fall!

You could head over here to get two $10 Groupons to spend at Creamistry (our all time favorite ice cream place) for $11.70 with code SALE3.
"Here's the scoop on how Creamistry keeps its frozen treats so fresh and creamy: the ice cream doesn't even exist before the customer places an order. The staff here doesn't scoop out cookies 'n' cream, vanilla, or chocolate from a large tub, but instead creates all of their ice cream by mixing bases, flavors, and mix-ins and flash-freezing them using pure liquid nitrogen.
What emerges from the clouds of vapor depends entirely on the customer's palate. The menu includes four bases (Premium, Organic, Non-Dairy Sorbet, and Vegan Coconut) and more than 60 flavors and toppings to choose from, offering endless combinations. "Each Pogo Pass holder receives Three (3) “All Day Admission Passes" to Play Factory, during ALL Regular Open Play Hours. "
Locally owned and family operated, The Play Factory is where everyone can climb, jump, bounce, slide, and weave their way through hours of fun exercise and entertainment! Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves One (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass. *Silver pass is good for Unlimited rides and 1 round of miniature golf.
The Phoenix Zoo: Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times.
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket starting May 16th, 2015 when full park opens for the season.
Arizona Diamondbacks: *One (1) ticket per game for Two (2) Arizona Diamondbacks home games. Available home games are posted under available hours.
Phoenix Rock Gym: Pogo Pass holders can attend Phoenix Rock Gym two (2) times.
Skateland: Each pass holder can attend Skateland two (2) times per month. Skateland has three (3) different locations available to pass holders.
Makutus Island: Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to Makutu's Island two (2) times. Available during regular business hours Monday-Friday. Excludes these major holidays: Memorial Day, Independance Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day and Veterans Day.

Available Monday-Thursday 11:00am-10:00pm, Fridays 11:00am-5pm. (Excludes Friday's after 5pm, Saturdays, Sundays and ALL Holidays)

IDEA Museum: Each pass holder can attend i.d.e.a Museum two (2) times during normal business hours.

Ibotta: Head to over here to download this totally free app. You'll save money at stores all over town like Target, Walmart, Fry's, Safeway, Bashas, Albertsons, Walgreens, even Sprouts and Whole Foods. Don't forget that you can get a Target Red Card to come right out of your bank account and they'll take 5% off all of your Target purchases. Head to my site to find out more and get yours.

Snag the Savings Catcher app and take a couple of seconds to scan your receipt or type in the numbers after you shop Walmart. They will check the competitors ads and if they find that you paid more than you would have somewhere else, they will give you a Walmart eGift Card for the difference. You'll pay $12 for two general admission tickets (a $20 value) or $21 for four (a $40 value).
"In 1955, 50 horses and their handlers gathered on the grounds of the Arizona Biltmore Hotel for the first Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show. Over the next 58 years, the event moved twice—first to Paradise Park, then to WestWorld—and grew to nearly 2,500 participants. Today, the 450 members of the Arabian Horse Association of Arizona, which was incorporated the same year as the horse show, help to oversee the annual flagship event. Many of the members also serve as competition judges, work to foster youth participation in the equestrian arts, and raise awareness about which tiny hats look best on thoroughbreds.
The annual Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show draws competitors from local Arizona farms and across the country. The showcase gathers thousands of horse enthusiasts for seminars, competitions, galas, international cuisine, and more than 300 vendors. Though the Arabian Horse Association of Arizona holds the show as its main event, it also oversees the Arabian Breeder Finals, a halter and breeding showcase; the annual qualifying America Cup Championship; and yearly endurance rides and stallion auctions."
Have fun!
